_README: Sequences for niche-2026 campaigns. Day 1 has 2 variants for A/B test: Founder Trap (frame-led) vs Sample-of-20 (artifact-led). Days 3/7/11/17 are uniform follow-ups with distinct jobs: insight, proof, qualifier, door-open. Locked rules: zero em dashes, zero exclamation marks, INSTANTLY spintax syntax {{RANDOM |a|b|c}} (NOT standard {a|b|c} — Instantly's parser only recognizes the RANDOM form per https://help.instantly.ai/en/articles/6384663-how-to-use-spintax), vars {{firstName}} {{companyName}} {{industryNiche}} {{senderFirst}}.

variants.subject: {{RANDOM |the math at {{companyName}}|{{firstName}}, retained-search math|quick read on {{companyName}}}}
variants.body:
{{firstName}},

Most retained-search founders are running a high-paying job, not a business. {{RANDOM |Every search comes from your network.|Every meeting traces back to someone you know.}} The firm has your name on it but runs on your relationships.

{{RANDOM |Works fine until two things happen at once|Fine until two things go wrong at the same time}} - a big client pauses hiring, and your network has nothing new in it.

I build the system that fills the calendar {{RANDOM |without your personal involvement|hands-off for you|so the rainmaking isn't on you}}.

{{RANDOM |Want a quick map of how this works for retained search specifically?|Mind if I send something useful instead of a pitch?|Want me to put a sample together for {{companyName}}?}}

{{senderFirst}}

variants.subject: {{RANDOM |20 of these for {{companyName}}|sample for {{companyName}}|{{firstName}}, want 20?}}
variants.body:
{{firstName}},

{{RANDOM |Spent 20 min on {{companyName}} this morning.|Took a quick look at {{companyName}} this morning.|Looked through {{companyName}} this morning.}}

{{RANDOM |If it's useful|If it'd help|If this is interesting}}, I can pull 20 verified contacts in your ICP - Heads of People / CHROs at companies actively scaling - and send them over. {{RANDOM |Yours whether we work together or not.|Yours regardless.|Free, no strings.}}

Takes me an hour. No pitch, just the list.

{{RANDOM |Want me to put it together for {{companyName}}?|Should I pull the 20 and send them?|Mind if I send the sample?}}

{{senderFirst}}

{{firstName}}, {{RANDOM |quick add-on.|one more thought.|small follow-up.}}

Counterintuitive thing about retained-search outbound: the highest-reply prospects are VPs in their first 90 days at a new role, not C-suite. {{RANDOM |New VPs are trying to make their mark and stay open to vendors C-suite would filter out.|They're building their org and haven't built filters yet.}}

Worth knowing whether you outsource outbound or do it in-house.

{{senderFirst}}

{{firstName}}, {{RANDOM |a quick data point|sharing a number|one stat worth knowing}}:

Retained-search firms running outbound at this scale typically land 2-3 qualified discovery calls per week from cold. Roughly 1 search engagement per month closes from that flow.

All from inboxes the senior team never touches.

{{RANDOM |Want to see what that looks like for {{companyName}}?|Worth a quick walkthrough?|Open to seeing how this would work?}}

{{senderFirst}}

{{firstName}}, {{RANDOM |last attempt.|honest question.|one more.}}

Is filling the search pipeline something {{companyName}} is actively working on, or is it sorted for now?

Either answer is fine - just want to know if I should follow up later.

{{senderFirst}}

{{firstName}}, {{RANDOM |closing the loop here.|stepping back.|done following up.}}

{{RANDOM |Not going to push further.|Won't keep nudging.}} If retained-search prospect flow ever comes up for {{companyName}}, you have my email.

{{RANDOM |Best with the practice.|Good luck with the year.|Wishing you a strong year.}}

{{senderFirst}}
